title: 部分分式展开：重极点（临界阻尼）
statement: 图示 RLC 串联电路中 v_s = 2u(t) V，R = 4 Ω，L = 1 H，C = 0.25 F。电感原来没有电流，电容原已充电 v_C(0₋) = 1 V（极性同图中 v_C 的参考方向：上“+”下“−”）。
回路电流 i 的参考方向如图。运算电路中，电容用 1/(sC) 与电压源 v_C(0₋)/s 串联，电压源的“+”在 v_C 的“+”一侧。求 I(s) 和 V_C(s)，把 V_C(s) 展开为 \frac{K_0}{s} + \frac{K_{11}}{(s + 2)²} + \frac{K_{12}}{s + 2}。再求 t = 0.5 s 时的 v_C 和 i。

questions.explain: 重极点的第二个系数要求导：K_12 = \frac{d}{ds}[(s + 2)²V_C(s)]_{s=−2}。(s + 2)²V_C(s) = \frac{(s + 2)²}{s} + \frac{4}{s}。第一项的导数在 s = −2 处为 0，所以 K_12 = −4/s²|_{s = −2} = −1。

questions.ask: 重极点 p（二重）在时域中对应的项是：
choiceExplain: 两项都是 e^{pt}，就只剩一个待定系数，不能满足两个初始条件。二重极点的 1/(s − p)² 项对应的不是 e^{pt}。
二重极点不是“极点加倍”，指数仍是 e^{pt}。
1/(s − p) 项对应的是 e^{pt}，不带 t。
questions.explain: ℒ⁻¹[1/(s − p)²] = te^{pt}，ℒ⁻¹[1/(s − p)] = e^{pt}，所以二重极点给出 (K_{11}t + K_{12})e^{pt}。临界阻尼响应里的 t·e^{−αt} 项就是这样来的。

hints: 运算电路：电源 2/s，电容 = 1/(sC) 串电压源 v_C(0₋)/s。回路电流 I(s) 由 KVL 求。

en.title: Partial fractions: a repeated pole (critical damping)
statement: In the series RLC circuit v_s = 2u(t) V, R = 4 Ω, L = 1 H, C = 0.25 F. The inductor carries no current initially and the capacitor is charged to v_C(0−) = 1 V (polarity as the reference of v_C: + at the top).

The loop current i is referenced as drawn. In the s-domain circuit the capacitor is 1/(sC) in series with a voltage source v_C(0−)/s, + on the + side of v_C. Find I(s) and V_C(s), and expand V_C(s) as \frac{K_0}{s} + \frac{K_{11}}{(s + 2)²} + \frac{K_{12}}{s + 2}. Then find v_C and i at t = 0.5 s.

questions.explain: The second coefficient of a double pole needs a derivative: K_12 = \frac{d}{ds}[(s + 2)²V_C(s)]_{s=−2}. (s + 2)²V_C(s) = \frac{(s + 2)²}{s} + \frac{4}{s}. The first term's derivative is 0 at s = −2, so K_12 = −4/s²|_{s = −2} = −1.

questions.ask: A double pole p gives the time-domain term:
questions.explain: ℒ⁻¹[1/(s − p)²] = te^{pt} and ℒ⁻¹[1/(s − p)] = e^{pt}, so a double pole gives (K_{11}t + K_{12})e^{pt}. This is where the t·e^{−αt} term of a critically damped response comes from.
choiceExplain: Two e^{pt} terms are really one unknown and cannot meet two initial conditions. The 1/(s − p)² term of a double pole does not correspond to e^{pt}.
A double pole does not double the exponent: it is still e^{pt}.
The 1/(s − p) term is plain e^{pt}, without t.

hints: s-domain circuit: source 2/s, capacitor = 1/(sC) in series with a voltage source v_C(0−)/s. Get the loop current I(s) from KVL.
The characteristic polynomial s² + 4s + 4 = (s + 2)² has a double root. K_11 = [(s + 2)²F]_{s=−2}, K_12 = \frac{d}{ds}[(s + 2)²F]_{s=−2}.
solution: **1. s-domain circuit.** Loop KVL: (4 + s + 4/s)I(s) = 2/s − 1/s → I(s) = \frac{1}{(s + 2)²}.
